insight: Zed Industries open-sourced the editor in 2024 and raised a $32M Series B led by Sequoia in 2025; it reached v1.0 in 2026.
name: Zed
tagline: The fast, open-source AI code editor in Rust, from the Atom creators.
description: A GPU-accelerated, Rust-built editor with first-class agentic AI — parallel agents, edit prediction, and an open Agent Client Protocol that plugs into Claude, GPT, Gemini, MCP servers, and external CLI agents like Claude Code. Fully open source (GPL-3); BYO key or an optional hosted Pro tier.

modelSupport.notes: BYO key or Zed-hosted Pro models; connects external agents via the Agent Client Protocol.

edge: GPU-accelerated Rust editor from the Atom/Tree-sitter creators, with an open protocol letting external agents drive it.
pros: Plugs in Claude Code and CLI agents
cons: Best on macOS, Linux catching up
